models.mechanism: The imperative commissions an utterance whose compact pronoun-name-predicate structure functions as a public definition: the referent identified as Allah is bounded by absolute oneness.

activation_trace.assigned_role: makes the clause an articulated declaration rather than an unspoken description

activation_trace.literal_contribution: definition or essence stated as qawl
activation_trace.assigned_role: frames the commissioned wording as a concise identity-definition

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Allah as a fixed divine name
activation_trace.assigned_role: anchors the otherwise pronominal referent in a fixed name
supplies the defining predicate that excludes internal plurality

structural_cues: An imperative precedes the entire clause, making saying part of the ayah's operation.
The sequence هو → الله → أحد moves from referent to fixed name to predication.
The short nominal clause has no narrated event, favoring identity formulation over temporal report.

abductive_moves.assumption: The commanded utterance is meant to stabilize and transmit a definition, not merely repeat information.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet supplies an imperative plus a self-contained nominal clause, while the definitional function is not explicitly marked.
alternatives: a one-time answer to an unstated question

abductive_moves.assumption: Absolute oneness bounds how the named referent may be conceived.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: أحد supplies oneness, but its use as a constraint on conception is an inferred effect.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: absolute-one predicate [supplied] → exclusion of internal plurality [inferred]

changed_reading.before: A command to say that He is Allah, One.
changed_reading.after: A commissioned public formula moves from an unspecified 'He' to the fixed divine name and then fixes that identity by absolute oneness.

models.ablation: Removing قل or the definitional branch of ق و ل collapses the performative model into a static assertion; removing أحد leaves identification without its bounding predicate.

surprise_reading: The line provisionally reads not only as information about God but as a commissioned act of definition: speech carries an initially pronominal referent into the fixed name Allah and seals that identity with absolute oneness.
